_doc: GATE 1 (doc/HubbardUPlan.md track B, B2) on LiMn2O4_spinel: does a CHOSEN ferromagnetic order on the spinel Mn (pyrochlore) sublattice survive a change in U?  Was `gpwprobe gate1 LiMn2O4_spinel <U_eV>`.

NOT a ground-state search (the NiO lesson, HubbardUPlan S1: seeding cannot buy an order the fixed point lacks) -- what matters is whether the order SURVIVES.  Every Mn site gets the SAME U (site, l=2); vary it:  --set solid.hubbard.0.U_eV=...  (one --set per site),
or regenerate the list.  Multiplicity = n_Mn*4+1 (FM, d-count derived; GATE1_MULT overrides).  U starts at 0.
